            <script>
                function setPoliteIndexCookie(id) {
                    let date = new Date();
                    date.setDate(date.getDate() + 7);
                    document.cookie = 'c-polite-popup-' + id + '=true; expires=' + date.toUTCString()

                }

                function newIndexVisit(id) {
                    if (document.cookie.split(';').filter((item) => item.trim().startsWith('c-polite-popup-' + id + '=')).length) {
                        return false;
                    } else {
                        return true;
                    }
                }

                function initIndexPopup() {

                    let _id = ko.contextFor($('.c-polite-pop-up__content .single-ad')[0]).$data.id;
                    let popup = document.getElementById('polite-pop-up');
                    let close = document.getElementById('polite-close');

                    if (newIndexVisit(_id) && window.matchMedia('(min-width:1px)').matches) {

                        //sets cookie automatically on load
                        //setPoliteIndexCookie(_id);

                        close.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            popup.classList.remove('is-active');

                            //sets cookie on close click
                            setPoliteIndexCookie(_id);
                        });

                        setTimeout(() => {
                            popup.classList.add('is-active');
                            
                        }, 3000);

                    } else {
                        console.log('in init index');
                        popup.parentNode.removeChild(popup);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                require(['knockout', 'jquery'], function (ko, $) {
                    let attemptsToRun = 0;
                    let popupSetter = setInterval(function () {
                        if ($('.c-polite-pop-up__content .single-ad').length) {
                            initIndexPopup();
                            clearInterval(popupSetter);
                        }

                        if (attemptsToRun > 20) {
                            //not always going to exist so let's kill it after a while
                            clearInterval(popupSetter);
                        }
                        ++attemptsToRun;

                    }, 500);
                });
            </script>
